name: Vampiric infection
description: Cold corruption is spreading through your blood. Seek Thoronir in the Fallhaven chapel before the change is complete.

name: Vampirism
description: The blood curse grants feeding powers but causes daytime weakness. Outdoors always counts as daylight; indoors always counts as darkness.

name: Sated
description: Fed and focused. In darkness, recover 1 HP after every 4 world rounds while sated. No regeneration outdoors.

name: Thirsty
description: The hunger is returning. Your focus is beginning to slip.

name: Starving
description: The blood hunger is consuming you. Feed on living prey soon.

name: Daylight exposure
description: Daylight exposure on outdoor maps disrupts your undead strength: -4 attack chance, -3 block chance and no passive healing.
